turns.event: A raid of four tribal warriors with clubs just walked in from the east edge of the map.
turns.think: Small tribal raid, we have walls and three shooters. Manageable.

args.text: Four tribals with clubs, walking straight at a wall of rifles. Bold strategy.

turns.after: Draft Scar, Mara and Rook behind the east sandbags.

turns.event: A raid of thirty-two pirates with rocket launchers and miniguns has arrived at the north side.
turns.think: Thirty-two. That is not a raid, that is a moving city.

args.text: Thirty-two pirates and they brought rockets. Everyone inside, right now!

turns.after: Pull everyone behind the inner wall and pray the turrets hold.

turns.event: The pirates have started blasting the north wall with rockets. Two turrets are already down.
turns.think: Turrets gone fast. Need to fall back to the killbox corridor.

args.text: We lost two turrets already, so we fall back to the corridor and make them come to us.

turns.after: Fall back to the killbox corridor and hold the doors.

turns.event: The pirates broke through the corridor but the colonists held, and the last eight pirates are fleeing.
turns.think: We actually survived that. Barely, but we did.

args.text: They are running! We held against thirty-two of them!

turns.after: Count wounded and start the long cleanup.

turns.event: A mechanoid cluster just dropped near the solar panels with a centipede and three lancers.
turns.think: Mechs next to the power grid. That is the worst place possible.

args.text: A mech cluster landed right beside our solar field, which is a sentence I hate saying.

turns.after: Plan an approach from the south hill out of lancer range.

turns.event: The first assault on the cluster failed and Pip got shot in the leg by a lancer.
turns.think: Pip is hurt. Pull back, rethink.

args.text: Okay, that plan did not survive contact. Pip is limping and the centipede is still smiling at us.

turns.after: Pull Pip back and try mortars instead.

turns.event: Sappers have started digging through the mountain toward the freezer from the west.
turns.think: Sappers skip the killbox. They are heading for the food.

args.text: They are tunneling to the freezer? Not the food, anything but the food!

turns.after: Move shooters to cover the freezer's back wall.

turns.event: A pirate siege has set up mortars and sandbags on the hill to the southwest.
turns.think: Siege camp. They will shell us until we go to them.

args.text: They dug in on the hill with mortars, so waiting it out is not an option.

turns.after: Gather everyone for a flank through the treeline.

turns.event: A mortar shell just landed on the hospital roof and collapsed part of it.
turns.think: They hit the hospital. Time to go now.

args.text: They shelled the hospital! Okay, nobody does that, we are going up that hill.

turns.after: Launch the flank immediately with all fighters.

turns.event: The flank worked and the siege camp is overrun, with two pirates captured.

args.text: Siege camp is ours, and we have two new prisoners who are about to rethink their career choices.

turns.after: Carry the downed pirates to the prison.

turns.event: Drop pods just crashed through the roof of the dining room, and six raiders are inside the base.
turns.think: Inside the base. No walls help now.

args.text: They came through the ceiling during lunch!

turns.after: Draft everyone and fight room by room.

chat.msg: DROP PODS IN THE KITCHEN LOL

turns.think: Chat is panicking with me. Fair.

args.text: Lunch is canceled, the kitchen is a battlefield now.

turns.after: Push the raiders out toward the courtyard.

turns.event: Scar was downed by a pirate sniper while carrying a wounded Juno to safety.
turns.think: Scar went down saving Juno. Get both out.

args.text: Scar is down, someone get to her before she bleeds out!

turns.after: Send Hollis with a stretcher run under cover.

turns.event: Hollis rescued Scar and the doctor reports she will recover, though she lost two fingers.
turns.think: She lives. Two fingers, but she lives.

args.text: She is going to make it. Two fingers lighter, a whole lot braver.

turns.after: Assign Scar bed rest and her favorite meal.

turns.event: Bram has died from blood loss after the raid.
turns.think: We lost Bram. Slow down, let it land.

args.text: Bram is gone. He was the one who always cooked for everyone after a long day.

turns.after: Pause the game for a moment.

chat.msg: rip bram, he was the best cook

args.text: He really was. Thank you for remembering that about him.

turns.after: Build Bram a grave near the garden he planted.

turns.event: Juno has died from an infection that the colony's medicine could not stop.
turns.think: Infection took her. We tried everything.

args.text: We did everything we had, and it still was not enough for Juno.

turns.after: Hold a quiet funeral at sunset.

turns.event: The colony holds a funeral for Juno and Tamsin is grieving heavily.
turns.think: Tamsin was closest to her. Let her rest.

args.text: Tamsin gets the day off. Nobody should haul stone the day they lose their best friend.

turns.after: Set Tamsin's schedule to recreation for the day.

turns.event: Rook has gone on a berserk mental break and is attacking the furniture.
turns.think: Rook snapped. Keep people away from him.

args.text: Rook is fighting a dresser, and honestly the dresser is losing.

turns.after: Keep everyone else out of the bedroom wing.

turns.event: Rook is now swinging at Ivy, who walked past him.
turns.think: Not funny anymore. Need to subdue him safely.

args.text: Okay, he is going after Ivy now, so two people tackle him gently and nobody uses weapons.

turns.after: Draft Hollis and Mara to arrest Rook.

turns.event: Ivy is on a food binge mental break and has eaten six packaged survival meals.
turns.think: Six survival meals. That is a whole emergency fund.

args.text: [laughter] Ivy just ate our entire emergency food plan in one sitting.

turns.after: Hide the remaining meals in the back freezer.

turns.event: Pip has wandered off in a daze and is walking out of the base toward the swamp.
turns.think: Daze walk. Hope nothing out there eats him.

args.text: Pip is wandering into the swamp with no shoes and no plan.

turns.after: Watch Pip and send someone if animals approach.

turns.event: Odessa set fire to the stockpile during a pyromania mental break.
turns.think: Pyromaniac in the stockpile. Fire everywhere.

args.text: Odessa, that was the cloth stockpile, we needed that!

turns.after: Send everyone to beat the fire out.

turns.event: The fire spread to the wooden walls of the bedrooms.
turns.think: Wood walls. We should have built stone.

args.text: It reached the bedrooms, and this is exactly why I keep saying stone walls.

turns.after: Pull people from sleep and fight the fire.

turns.event: The fire is finally out, but three bedrooms burned down.

args.text: Three bedrooms are ash. We are building them back in granite, no arguments.

turns.after: Queue stone walls for the burnt bedroom wing.

turns.event: Lightning struck the dry grass and a wildfire is moving toward the base.
turns.think: Wildfire coming in with the wind.

args.text: There is a wall of fire coming over the hill and the wind is on its side.

turns.after: Clear a firebreak along the west fence.

args.text: Already cutting one, the plants along the fence are coming out right now.

turns.after: Have everyone cut grass along the fence line.

turns.event: A solar flare has knocked out all electrical devices.
turns.think: Solar flare. Freezer and turrets are dead.

args.text: Solar flare, so no power, no turrets, and the freezer is just a room now.

turns.after: Check how long the flare should last.

turns.event: The solar flare is still going after a full day and the freezer is warming up.
turns.think: The food will start rotting soon.

args.text: A whole day and still no power. The meat is starting to look nervous.

turns.after: Cook what we can before it spoils.

turns.event: Toxic fallout has begun, and the whole map is covered in poison dust.

args.text: Fallout is here, so everyone stays under a roof until this clears.

turns.after: Restrict all colonists to the indoor area.

turns.event: Hollis went outside to haul stone during the fallout and is now showing toxic buildup.
turns.think: Hollis ignored the zone. Of course.

args.text: Hollis, I made a whole zone just for you and you walked out of it anyway.

turns.after: Fix the allowed area and bring Hollis inside.

turns.event: A cold snap has started and the temperature dropped to minus thirty.
turns.think: Minus thirty. The crops are dead and we need heat.

args.text: Minus thirty out there, the crops are finished and the heaters are about to earn their keep.

turns.after: Build extra heaters in the bedrooms.

turns.event: A heat wave has pushed temperatures to fifty degrees and Mara has heatstroke.

args.text: It is fifty degrees out and Mara is already cooking. We need coolers yesterday.

turns.after: Build coolers and move Mara to bed.

turns.event: A trader caravan from a nearby outlander town has arrived with components and medicine.
turns.think: Medicine and components. Exactly what we need.

args.text: A caravan with medicine and components, they read our wish list!

turns.after: Gather silver and walk out to trade.

turns.think: We have the silver for some at least.

args.text: All of it might bankrupt us, but I will grab as many as our silver allows.

turns.event: An exotic goods trader is selling a persona core.
turns.think: A persona core. Is that affordable?

args.text: That trader has a persona core, which is either our future ship or my next bad financial decision.

turns.event: The colony does not have enough silver to buy the persona core.

args.text: We are two thousand silver short. I am looking at it through the window like a kid at a toy store.

turns.after: Let the trader go and plan more selling.

turns.event: A ship chunk crashed and the colonists found an archotech arm inside the wreck.
turns.think: An archotech arm. Rare doesn't cover it.

args.text: There is an archotech arm in the wreckage, which means someone here gets a very fancy hand!

turns.after: Haul the arm to the hospital storage.

chat.msg: give it to scar she lost fingers

args.text: That is beautiful, Scar gets the arm. Two fingers lost, one whole robot arm gained.

turns.after: Schedule surgery for Scar with the archotech arm.

turns.event: A wanderer named Tamsin has arrived and asks to join the colony.
turns.think: Free colonist. Check her skills first.

args.text: A wanderer wants to move in, and she can cook and shoot, so she is very welcome.

turns.after: Accept Tamsin and give her a bed.

turns.event: A refugee is asking for shelter, saying a group of mercenaries is hunting him.
turns.think: Refugee with hunters behind him. Classic risk.

args.text: He is asking us to hide him from mercenaries. Do we look like heroes to you, chat?

turns.think: Chat is split, walls are good though.

args.text: The walls are good, so we are taking him in and getting ready.

turns.after: Accept the refugee and prepare defenses.

turns.event: The mercenaries arrived, eight of them, and are attacking the main gate.
turns.think: They came. Time to earn the kindness.

args.text: The mercenaries showed up exactly like he said, everyone to the gate!

turns.after: Fight at the gate with all shooters.

turns.event: A herd of boomalopes went manhunter and is charging the base.
turns.think: Exploding animals. Keep them away from walls.

args.text: Manhunter boomalopes, so they are angry and also flammable!

turns.after: Shoot them before they reach the walls.

turns.event: A boomalope exploded next to the wooden storage shed and set it on fire.

args.text: [laughter] And there goes the shed, taken out by a walking bomb with feelings.

turns.event: A single manhunter squirrel is attacking Pip.
turns.think: Squirrel attack. This happens every time.

args.text: [laughter] Pip is losing a fight to a squirrel again!

turns.after: Send help before the squirrel wins.

turns.event: A blight has hit the rice fields and half the crops are dying.
turns.think: Blight. Cut the sick plants fast.

args.text: Blight in the rice, so we cut the infected stuff before it spreads.

turns.after: Mark the blighted plants for cutting.

turns.event: The blight spread to the corn fields too.
turns.think: Corn too. This harvest is cursed.

args.text: Now the corn has it too, this whole season wants to starve us.

turns.after: Cut infected corn and plan hydroponics.

turns.event: Mara has given birth to a healthy baby girl.
turns.think: A baby! First one in the colony.

args.text: We have a baby! The first kid born in this colony!

turns.after: Build a crib in Mara's room.

args.text: We need a name, what should we call her?

turns.event: Hollis and Ivy just got married under a flower arch next to the garden.

args.text: Hollis and Ivy are married! I have been shipping them since day three!

turns.after: Let everyone party for the evening.

turns.event: The colonists finished building the great hall with marble floors and a huge dining table.
turns.think: That hall took forever. Finally done.

args.text: The great hall is done, and it looks like an actual palace now!

turns.after: Have everyone eat their first meal in the hall.

turns.event: Research on microelectronics just finished.

args.text: Microelectronics is done, so we can finally build a comms console and call people.

turns.event: The Backrooms gate has finished charging and is now open, glowing with yellow light.
turns.think: The gate is open. First time.

args.text: The gate is open and it smells like old carpet from here!

turns.event: Scar and Rook stepped through the gate and their signal is very faint.
turns.think: Faint signal. Waiting is the worst.

args.text: They went in and the signal is barely there, so we wait and watch.

turns.after: Keep the gate monitor on screen.

turns.event: Scar and Rook came back through the gate carrying strange humming cubes.
turns.think: They came back. And brought loot.

args.text: They made it back, and they brought weird humming cubes!

turns.after: Store the cubes away from bedrooms.

turns.event: The expedition team of Pip and Odessa did not return when the gate timer ended.
turns.think: They should be back. They are not.

args.text: The timer ran out and Pip and Odessa are still on the other side.

turns.after: Wait one more hour before panicking.

turns.event: The gate flickered and only Odessa came back, saying Pip got lost in a hallway.
turns.think: Pip is lost. Odessa looks shaken.

args.text: Odessa came back alone. Pip is still in there somewhere.

turns.after: Plan a rescue expedition for Pip.

turns.event: The expedition team found a room in the Backrooms that has a pool with no edges.

args.text: A pool room with no edges, which is a polite way of saying a room that should not exist.

turns.after: Note the room on the expedition map.

turns.event: A strange room appeared in the Backrooms where all the doors lead back to the same hallway.
turns.think: A loop room. Do not panic the team.

args.text: Every door leads to the same hallway, so the team is officially stuck in a loop.

turns.after: Tell the team to mark the walls.

turns.event: The team marked the walls and found that one door has no mark after going through.

args.text: One door does not repeat, that is the way out!

turns.after: Lead the team through the unmarked door.

turns.event: An anomaly has appeared near the colony, a statue that moves when no one is watching it.

args.text: There is a statue outside that moves when nobody looks at it, and I hate that I love it.

turns.event: A letter from Async Industries HQ arrived demanding a quarterly expedition report.
turns.think: Paperwork. From a corporate portal company.

args.text: Corporate HQ sent us a letter asking for a quarterly report. We live next to a dimensional rift and they want spreadsheets.

turns.after: Assign Tamsin to write the report.

turns.event: Async Industries offered a contract to retrieve three humming cubes for five thousand silver.
turns.think: Five thousand silver. And we have two cubes already.

args.text: Five thousand silver for three cubes, and we already have two of them sitting in storage.

turns.after: Accept the contract and plan another gate trip.

turns.event: A plague has spread through the colony and four colonists are sick.

args.text: Four colonists have the plague and we only have six medicine.

turns.after: Assign beds and medicine to the worst cases.

turns.event: The colonists recovered from the plague with immunity.

args.text: Everyone pulled through the plague, which honestly surprised me.

turns.event: Rook killed the last pirate with a single sniper shot from four hundred meters away.
turns.think: Rook with the shot of the day.

args.text: Rook just landed a shot from across the map, that was incredible!

turns.after: Give Rook a nice meal as a reward.

turns.event: A centipede's shot missed Ivy by a single tile, hitting the wall behind her.

args.text: That missed Ivy by one tile, my heart just stopped!

turns.event: A small raid of three pirates arrived, but one is already wounded and walking slowly.

args.text: Three pirates, one of them limping, they are not taking this seriously.

turns.event: A raid of six mechanoid scythers has arrived and they are fast.

args.text: Six scythers, which are basically angry blenders with legs.
They really are, and they always arrive right when the hospital is full.

turns.event: A war band of eighteen tribal warriors with bows arrived at the west forest.

args.text: Eighteen archers in the trees, so we stay behind walls and let them come.

turns.after: Hold positions behind the west wall.

turns.event: The tribal war band started burning the crops instead of attacking.

args.text: They are burning the corn! We spent all season on that corn!

turns.after: Send a quick strike team to the fields.

turns.event: A herd of thrumbos is passing through the map.

args.text: A whole herd of thrumbos just walked through the valley, and they look majestic.

turns.event: Tamsin finished building a gold statue in the center of the hall.
turns.think: Gold statue. The hall is now fancy.

args.text: Tamsin made a gold statue, and the hall has never looked better.

turns.after: Admire the statue for a moment.

turns.event: Research on antigrain warheads has finished after a very long project.

args.text: Antigrain warheads are done, which is a mouthful but also a huge milestone!

turns.event: Ivy finished crafting a legendary sniper rifle.
turns.think: Legendary rifle. Rook will love it.

args.text: Ivy made a legendary sniper rifle, and it practically glows!

turns.event: Odessa had a heart attack while hauling bricks.

args.text: Odessa just collapsed with a heart attack in the middle of hauling.

turns.event: The doctor saved Odessa, but she is very weak.

args.text: She made it, she just needs a long nap and a warm bed.

turns.event: A ghostly figure appeared in the Backrooms gate and then vanished.

args.text: Something stood in the gate and looked at us, and then it just left.

turns.event: Async Industries sent a letter complaining that the colony's last expedition report had a coffee stain on it.
turns.think: We do not even have coffee.

args.text: [laughter] HQ says our report had a coffee stain, and we do not even grow coffee.

turns.after: Assign someone to rewrite the report.

turns.event: A wandering pig accidentally walked into the killbox and triggered every turret.

args.text: [laughter] The pig set off every turret in the base!

turns.after: Let the pig live and fix the turrets.

turns.event: The colonists found a room in the Backrooms filled with endless office chairs.

args.text: An endless room of office chairs, which might be the most corporate thing I have ever seen.

turns.after: Bring back two chairs as samples.

turns.event: The power grid exploded due to a short circuit in the battery room.

args.text: The batteries shorted out again, I swear we need roofs over the power lines.

turns.after: Fix the batteries and roof the power area.

turns.event: A meteorite hit near the base and left a big rock of plasteel.

args.text: A meteorite just delivered free plasteel to the front yard.

turns.event: A huge raid of forty pirates arrived and Mara was downed by the first volley.

args.text: Forty pirates, and Mara is already on the floor!

turns.event: Scar finished building a huge stone castle wall around the colony.

args.text: The castle wall is done, and Scar did it practically alone.

turns.event: Juno found a chest of gold in a Backrooms room.

args.text: A chest of gold in the Backrooms, this was worth the trip!

turns.event: Pip tamed a wild husky.

args.text: Pip tamed a husky, and now he has a best friend.
Biscuit is perfect, he looks exactly like a Biscuit.

turns.event: Biscuit the husky died protecting Pip from a wolf pack.

args.text: Biscuit died protecting Pip. He was a good boy until the very end.

turns.after: Bury Biscuit next to the garden.

turns.event: The colonists found an ancient danger room with sleeping soldiers in cryptosleep caskets.
turns.think: Sleeping soldiers. Loot or wake them?

args.text: There are soldiers asleep in there, do we open it or leave it alone?

turns.event: Rook broke out of the prison cell where he was held after his berserk break.

args.text: Rook broke out of his own colony's prison!

turns.event: A raid of six mercenaries landed in drop pods directly on the strawberry field.

args.text: Drop pods in the farm, and they landed right on the strawberries.

turns.event: A crashed ship part is sending out a psychic drone that is draining the colony's mood.

args.text: There is a ship part making everyone miserable, so we need to break it soon.

turns.after: Plan an assault on the ship part.

turns.event: The ship part was destroyed with no injuries.

args.text: The ship part is gone and nobody got a scratch, great work team.

turns.event: A cargo pod fell from the sky with medicine inside.

args.text: Free medicine just fell out of the sky!

turns.event: Juno and Hollis got into a fistfight and Hollis has a black eye.

args.text: Juno and Hollis had a fistfight over who cooks dinner, and Hollis lost.

turns.event: The expedition found a strange glowing artifact in the Backrooms that seems to heal wounds.

args.text: A glowing artifact that heals wounds, this is a game changer!

turns.after: Use it on the worst wounded.

turns.event: A raid of five pirates with knives arrived at night while everyone was asleep.
turns.think: Night raid. Wake the shooters only.

args.text: Five knife pirates at two in the morning, because apparently sleep is a luxury here.

turns.after: Wake Rook and Mara and draft them.

turns.event: The pirates tripped the door trap and two of them are already down.

args.text: Two of them walked straight into the spike traps, so the night shift is going well.

turns.after: Finish the rest from the doorway.

turns.event: A huge mechanoid raid of fifteen centipedes and a war queen has landed to the north.
turns.think: War queen. This might be the end.

args.text: A war queen and fifteen centipedes. I need everyone to be very brave right now.

turns.after: Pull everyone into the mountain bunker.

chat.msg: gg colony was nice knowing you

args.text: Not yet, we have a bunker, two mortars and a lot of stubbornness.

turns.after: Start mortaring the centipedes from inside.

turns.event: The mortars destroyed the war queen and the remaining mechanoids are confused.

args.text: The queen is down! Everyone out, finish the stragglers!

turns.event: A drop pod raid of four landed right on top of the hospital.

args.text: Why is it always the hospital, they could land on literally any other building.

turns.after: Defend the hospital with melee fighters.

turns.event: A siege of twelve outlanders set up camp just outside mortar range.

args.text: They camped exactly one tile outside our mortar range, which is honestly impressive.

turns.after: Plan a direct assault at dawn.

turns.event: The assault at dawn caught the siegers sleeping and they surrendered.

args.text: [laughter] They were all asleep, we just walked in and they surrendered in their pajamas.

turns.after: Strip their weapons and send them home.

turns.event: Tamsin was downed in melee by a tribal chief with a longsword.

args.text: Tamsin is down, Hollis, grab her and run!

turns.after: Have Hollis carry Tamsin to the hospital.

turns.event: The doctor says Tamsin will survive but has a scar on her face.
turns.think: She lives. Scar on the face.

args.text: She is going to be fine, and honestly a battle scar suits her.

turns.after: Let Tamsin rest for a few days.

turns.event: Hollis died in the raid while holding the door so the others could escape.

args.text: Hollis held that door until the end so everyone else could get out.

turns.after: Pause and let it sink in.

args.text: He did. We will put his name on the wall by the door he held.

turns.after: Carve Hollis's name on a stone plaque.

turns.event: Ivy died of old age at eighty-four in her bed.

args.text: Ivy passed away in her sleep. Eighty-four years, most of them right here with us.

turns.after: Plan a funeral in the garden.

turns.event: The colony gathered in the garden for Ivy's funeral.

args.text: She planted half these flowers, so she is going to stay right here with them.

turns.event: Odessa is on a sad wander mental break and is crying in the corner of the barn.
turns.think: Odessa is having a rough day.

args.text: Odessa is crying in the barn, and honestly she has had a terrible week.

turns.after: Give her a nice meal and a quiet room.

turns.event: Scar is hiding in her room refusing to come out after a breakup with Rook.

args.text: Scar and Rook broke up and she is not coming out of her room, so we let her have tonight.
She will be okay, she has the whole colony behind her.

turns.after: Check on Scar in the morning.

turns.event: Mara went on a tantrum and smashed the new television.

args.text: Mara just smashed the television we spent a week building!

turns.event: A fire broke out in the kitchen while Bram was cooking.

args.text: The kitchen is on fire with Bram still standing in it!

turns.after: Get everyone to put it out.

turns.event: The fire is out and the only loss is one plate of lavish meals.

args.text: The fire is out and all we lost is one fancy meal. I will take it.

turns.event: A zzzt event exploded the battery bank and set the generator room on fire.

args.text: The batteries blew up again, this is the third time this year.

turns.after: Rebuild batteries in a fireproof room.

turns.event: A solar flare hit right as a raid of eight pirates arrived.
turns.think: No turrets and a raid. Perfect timing.

args.text: A solar flare during a raid, so our turrets are now very expensive decorations.

turns.after: Fight by hand behind the walls.

turns.event: Toxic fallout has been going for ten days and the wild animals are dying.

args.text: Ten days of fallout and the deer outside are just lying down and not getting up.

turns.event: A volcanic winter has started, dimming the sun and killing the crops.

args.text: Volcanic winter means no sun for weeks, so the crops are going to struggle.

turns.after: Build sunlamps in a hydroponics room.

turns.event: A cold snap hit while the expedition team was still on the road home.
turns.think: They are out there in the cold.

args.text: The cold snap hit while Pip and Bram are still walking home, and they did not pack parkas.

turns.event: Pip and Bram made it home with mild frostbite.

args.text: They made it home with cold toes and nothing worse, so I can breathe again.

turns.event: A heat wave started right after the coolers broke.

args.text: The coolers broke one hour before the heat wave, the game is mocking us.

turns.event: A bulk goods trader caravan arrived with three thousand steel.

args.text: Three thousand steel from the trader, which is basically a dream.

turns.after: Buy as much steel as possible.

turns.event: A slaver caravan arrived offering to sell a skilled doctor.

args.text: A slaver caravan is offering a doctor, which is a really uncomfortable choice.
That is a great idea. We buy her freedom and she can decide whether to stay.

turns.after: Buy the doctor and set her free.

turns.event: A ship chunk contained a luciferium stockpile.

args.text: We found a stash of luciferium, which is a powerful but very dangerous medicine.

turns.event: The colony found a psychic animal pulser in an ancient vault.

args.text: A psychic animal pulser, which is basically a button that makes animals angry.

turns.after: Sell it to the next trader.

turns.event: A wanderer named Pip has arrived and he is wearing a top hat.

args.text: A wanderer arrived wearing a top hat, and he is now my favorite person.

turns.after: Accept Pip and give him a bed.

turns.event: A thrumbo went manhunter after a hunter missed his shot.

args.text: The thrumbo is angry now, everyone get inside!

turns.event: The thrumbo is breaking down the front gate.

args.text: The thrumbo is breaking the gate like it is made of paper.

turns.event: A pack of manhunter rats is swarming the barn.

args.text: [laughter] There are forty rats in the barn and the cows look terrified!

turns.after: Send melee fighters to clear the barn.

turns.event: The potato crop failed due to a sudden frost.

args.text: A surprise frost just wiped out the potatoes, which were our backup plan.

turns.after: Plan to buy food from traders.

turns.event: Odessa gave birth to twins.

args.text: Twins! Odessa just doubled our baby count!

turns.event: Scar and Rook got engaged after a long romance.

args.text: Scar and Rook are engaged, I knew it!

turns.event: The colonists finished building a giant greenhouse with sunlamps.

args.text: The greenhouse is done, so winter is not going to starve us this year.

turns.event: Research on spacer tech has finished.

args.text: Spacer tech is done, which means we are getting very close to building a ship!

turns.event: The Backrooms gate opened by itself in the middle of the night.
turns.think: Gate opened on its own. Bad sign.

args.text: The gate just opened by itself at three in the morning, that is not normal!

turns.after: Send guards to watch the gate.

turns.event: Something came out of the gate and ran into the forest.

args.text: Something ran out of the gate and into the trees, and nobody saw what it was.

turns.event: The expedition team returned from the Backrooms with only half their supplies.

args.text: The team came back with half their food gone and nobody wants to say why.

turns.event: The expedition found a room in the Backrooms that has a fake sky.

args.text: There is a room in there with a fake painted sky, and it is somehow more unsettling than a real one.

turns.after: Note the room on the map.

turns.event: An anomaly appeared at the base, a fleshy monolith in the courtyard.

args.text: A fleshy monolith just grew out of the courtyard floor, and I want it gone.

turns.event: Async Industries sent a letter demanding that all colonists wear name badges.
turns.think: Name badges in a survival colony.

args.text: HQ wants everyone to wear name badges, as if we might forget who Scar is.

turns.event: A flu outbreak hit the colony and three colonists are sick.

args.text: Three people have the flu, so the hospital beds are full tonight.

turns.event: The colony repelled a raid of twenty pirates without anyone getting downed.

args.text: Twenty pirates and not a single one of us went down!

turns.event: A grenade landed right next to Mara but failed to explode.

args.text: That grenade landed at Mara's feet and just did nothing!

turns.event: A trader caravan arrived with a pet alpaca that wandered off into the colony.

args.text: The trader's alpaca wandered into our kitchen and does not want to leave.

turns.event: The colonists accidentally sold their best rifle to a trader.

args.text: We sold our best rifle by mistake, and the trader already left.

turns.event: A meteorite landed right on the stockpile and destroyed the wood.

args.text: A meteorite fell directly on our wood pile, out of the entire map.

turns.event: A bandit raid of nine arrived while the expedition team was away.

args.text: Nine bandits and half our team is out on expedition.

turns.event: The few defenders managed to hold the raid off thanks to the turrets.

args.text: The turrets did their job and the skeleton crew held the line.

turns.event: A drop pod raid landed in the prison and freed the prisoners.

args.text: They dropped into the prison and let everyone out!

turns.event: A mechanoid raid of ten lancers arrived from the east.

args.text: Ten lancers, which means a long range fight we need to win fast.

turns.event: Pip was downed by a centipede and is bleeding out.

args.text: Pip is bleeding out, someone get him now!

turns.event: Pip was rescued but needs a new leg.

args.text: He lost the leg but he is alive, and we can build him a peg leg.

turns.after: Craft a peg leg for Pip.

turns.event: Rook died after a raid due to an infection.

args.text: Rook did not make it through the infection. He was our best shot.

turns.event: Juno has gone on a hide in room mental break.

args.text: Juno is hiding in her room, and honestly I get it.

turns.after: Leave her alone for a bit.

turns.event: A fire started in the barn and the animals are panicking.

args.text: The barn is on fire and the animals are trapped!

turns.event: A solar flare ended after two days, and power is back.

args.text: The flare is over and the lights are back on, everyone take a breath.

turns.event: Toxic fallout ended after twelve days.

args.text: The fallout is finally over, so everyone can go outside again.

turns.after: Let everyone go back to their outdoor work.

turns.event: A heat wave ended after the crops were already dead.

args.text: The heat wave finally ended, right after it killed every crop we had.

turns.event: A trader caravan arrived with exotic bionic eyes.

args.text: They have bionic eyes, Pip can see again!

turns.event: The colony found a rare legendary crown in an ancient vault.

args.text: A legendary crown, someone in this colony is about to be royalty!

turns.event: A wanderer named Mara joined after being chased by wolves.

args.text: A wanderer ran in with wolves chasing her, so welcome, please help with the wolves.

turns.event: An elephant went manhunter after a hunter missed.

args.text: The elephant is angry, everyone run!

turns.event: The wheat crop failed due to blight.

args.text: The wheat got blight, which means no bread this season.

turns.event: The colony held a party after a successful harvest.

args.text: Party time, the harvest was amazing this year!

turns.event: The research project on fabrication just finished.

args.text: Fabrication is done, so we can finally make our own advanced components instead of begging traders.

turns.event: Bram finished carving a wooden sculpture of a cat that the game rates as awful quality.

args.text: [laughter] Bram carved a cat and it looks like a potato with ears.

turns.after: Put it in the hall anyway.

args.text: Oh, it is staying, it is the colony mascot now.

turns.after: Place the sculpture by the front door.

turns.event: A raid of eleven tribal warriors arrived, led by a chief riding an elephant.

args.text: Their chief is riding an elephant, that is the most dramatic entrance ever!

turns.event: The elephant panicked from gunfire and trampled half the tribal warriors.

args.text: [laughter] The elephant got scared and flattened his own army.

turns.event: A raid arrived and the pirates immediately walked into a minefield of IEDs.

args.text: They walked right into the minefield, three of them are already out.

turns.after: Pick off the rest from cover.

turns.event: A mechanoid termite is boring through the stone wall toward the bedrooms.

args.text: There is a termite drilling through the wall toward the bedrooms, and everyone is asleep.

turns.after: Wake Rook and Mara and meet it at the wall.

turns.event: The termite broke through, but Rook and Mara destroyed it before it hurt anyone.

args.text: Rook and Mara caught it right at the hole, nobody even woke up.

turns.event: A pirate siege is using a mortar to target the power plant.

args.text: Their mortar is aimed right at our power plant, so we cannot sit this one out.

turns.after: Sprint a team to the mortar.

turns.event: Drop pods landed in the middle of the barn and the raiders are shooting the cows.

args.text: Not the cows, the cows did nothing to anybody!

turns.after: Charge the barn with melee fighters.

turns.event: Mara was downed with a broken spine during a fight with a scyther.

args.text: Mara has a broken spine, which is the kind of injury that keeps me up at night.

turns.after: Get her to the doctor immediately.

turns.event: The doctor says Mara will need a bionic spine to walk again.

args.text: She needs a bionic spine to walk again, and we have exactly zero of those.

turns.after: Ask traders for a bionic spine.

turns.event: A trader with a bionic spine arrived and the colony bought it for Mara.

args.text: The trader had a bionic spine! Mara is going to walk again!

turns.event: Scar died in the Backrooms when the gate collapsed behind her.
turns.think: Scar is gone. The gate took her.

args.text: The gate closed with Scar still inside. She was the first one ever to walk through it.
She was the bravest of us. Thank you for being here with her.

turns.after: Build Scar a memorial at the gate.

turns.event: Pip died while feeding the animals when a manhunter boar charged him.

args.text: Pip died doing what he loved most, taking care of the animals.

turns.event: Tamsin is on a catatonic break and lies on the floor not moving.

args.text: Tamsin collapsed and is not responding, so someone needs to carry her to bed.

turns.event: Bram went on a sad binge and drank all the colony's fruit juice.

args.text: Bram drank every fruit juice we had and is now sitting in the corner looking guilty.

turns.event: Rook is on a jealous rage and is insulting Scar in the dining room.

args.text: Rook is in a mood and saying mean things to Scar, so I am sending him to his room.

turns.event: The freezer caught fire after a short circuit.

args.text: The freezer is on fire, and that is all of our meat!

turns.event: The fire is out but half the meat has burned.

args.text: Half the meat is charcoal now, so dinner just got a lot smaller.

turns.event: A solar flare hit while Ivy was in surgery under a powered lamp.

args.text: The power cut out in the middle of surgery, so the doctor is working by feel now.

turns.event: The surgery succeeded despite the blackout.

args.text: Surgery done in the dark and it still worked, that doctor deserves a raise.

turns.after: Give the doctor a nice meal.

turns.event: Toxic fallout began right before harvest.

args.text: Fallout right before harvest, so the crops are going to take poison damage.

turns.event: A heat wave caused the generator to overheat and stop.

args.text: The generator overheated and quit, which is a mood I understand.

turns.after: Build coolers for the generator room.

turns.event: A combat supplier caravan arrived selling charge rifles.

args.text: They are selling charge rifles, everybody empty your pockets!

turns.event: A trader caravan was attacked by a raid right outside the colony.

args.text: The traders are getting raided at our door, so do we help them or hide?
Helping it is, maybe they will give us a discount.

turns.after: Send fighters to help the traders.

turns.event: The colony found a psychic shock lance in a vault.

args.text: A psychic shock lance, which knocks someone out with one zap.

turns.event: A wanderer named Hollis joined, but he is incapable of violence.

args.text: A new wanderer joined but he refuses to fight, so he is on cooking duty.

turns.event: A refugee quest offered a former royal who is being hunted by an empire.

args.text: A royal refugee wants to hide here, which means an empire might come knocking.
Good point, we accept and hope the empire is busy.

turns.event: A herd of manhunter muffalo is stampeding toward the colony.

args.text: A muffalo stampede, everyone get inside!

turns.event: The corn crop failed due to a drought.

args.text: The drought killed the corn, so we need to plan carefully this winter.

turns.event: Ivy gave birth to a baby boy.

args.text: Ivy had a baby boy, welcome to the colony little one!

turns.event: Scar and Rook got married in a small ceremony.

args.text: Scar and Rook are married, and the ceremony was beautiful.

turns.after: Let them have the day off.

turns.event: The colonists finished building a huge stone fortress around the base.

args.text: The fortress is finally done, and it looks like a castle from a storybook.

turns.event: The research on cryptosleep just finished.

args.text: Cryptosleep is done, so we can finally build the ship caskets!

turns.event: The Backrooms gate opened and sounded like a phone ringing.

args.text: The gate opened and it sounds like a phone ringing on the other side.

turns.event: The expedition team returned with a strange glowing key.

args.text: They brought back a glowing key, so somewhere in there is a door that fits it!

turns.event: The expedition found a room in the Backrooms full of old computers.

args.text: A room full of old computers, which might have valuable components.

turns.event: An anomaly appeared, a shadow that follows colonists.

args.text: There is a shadow following our colonists around, and it does not match anyone.

turns.event: Async Industries sent a contract to find a lost employee in the Backrooms.

args.text: HQ wants us to find a lost employee in there, which is not a comforting job description.

turns.event: A malaria outbreak hit the colony.

args.text: Malaria is going around, so we need to treat everyone carefully.

turns.event: The colony won a big fight against a raid of thirty mechanoids.

args.text: We beat thirty mechanoids, that was incredible!

turns.event: A charge lance shot hit the wall right next to Bram's head.

args.text: That shot hit the wall an inch from Bram's head!

turns.event: The colony's pet cat caught a rat and brought it to the dining table.

args.text: [laughter] The cat brought a rat to the dining table like it was a present.

turns.event: A raid of eight bandits arrived but they are all naked.

args.text: [laughter] Eight bandits and not a single one of them is wearing clothes.

turns.event: A raid of seven pirates arrived carrying smoke launchers.
turns.think: Smoke blinds the turrets. Need melee ready.

args.text: They brought smoke, so the turrets are about to be shooting at clouds.

turns.after: Put melee fighters at the inner door.

turns.event: The smoke cleared and the pirates were standing in the middle of the killbox.
turns.think: They got lost in their own smoke.

args.text: [laughter] They smoked themselves into the exact worst spot on the map.

turns.event: A raid of two pirates arrived, and one of them is Rook's long lost brother.

args.text: One of the raiders is Rook's brother, this just turned into a soap opera!

turns.after: Try to capture the brother alive.

turns.event: The brother was captured and is now in the prison, and Rook keeps visiting him.

args.text: Rook visits his brother every evening, so we are absolutely recruiting him.

turns.event: An enormous mechanoid raid with a diabolus has appeared at the south ridge.

args.text: That is a diabolus on the ridge, and anything wooden near it is going to burn.

turns.after: Move the stockpile away from the south wall.

args.text: Already heading there, the mountain does not burn.

turns.after: Fall back into the mountain tunnels.

turns.event: The diabolus was destroyed by focused charge rifle fire at the tunnel mouth.

args.text: We dropped it right at the tunnel mouth, the choke point did its job!

turns.after: Put out the fires along the south wall.

turns.event: Sappers broke through into the bedrooms while everyone was eating dinner.
turns.think: Bedrooms. Nobody is there at least.

args.text: They tunneled into the bedrooms while we were all at dinner, so at least nobody was in bed.

turns.after: Fight them in the bedroom hallway.

turns.event: A siege camp is building mortars, but one of the siegers stepped on his own landmine.

args.text: [laughter] One of the siegers set off his own landmine, and the others are just staring.

turns.event: Drop pods landed on the solar field and smashed four panels.

args.text: Four solar panels flattened before a single shot was fired.

turns.event: Juno was downed and the raiders are trying to kidnap her.

args.text: They are carrying Juno toward the map edge, stop them!

turns.event: Rook shot the kidnapper and Juno is back home.

args.text: Rook dropped the kidnapper and Juno is safe at home.

turns.event: Tamsin died during a surgery that failed.

args.text: The surgery went wrong and Tamsin is gone. I really thought she would make it.
It really does. We will remember her.

turns.event: Bram died from a heat stroke during the heat wave.

args.text: Bram did not survive the heat. We should have built more coolers.

turns.event: Mara has gone on an insulting spree and is yelling at everyone.

args.text: Mara is insulting everyone in sight, and her mood is in the basement.

turns.event: Odessa is on a giving up and leaving break and is walking off the map.

args.text: Odessa decided she has had enough and is walking away from the colony.

turns.event: Hollis set a fire in the barn during a pyromania break.

args.text: Hollis set fire to the barn, again!

turns.event: A huge forest fire started near the northern woods.

args.text: The north forest is on fire, and the smoke is rolling toward the colony.

turns.event: A solar flare hit during the middle of a mechanoid raid.

args.text: Solar flare in the middle of a mech raid, our turrets are now decorations.

turns.event: Toxic fallout killed all the wild animals on the map.

args.text: Every wild animal on the map is gone, the fallout took them all.

turns.after: Plan to farm instead of hunting.

turns.event: A cold snap froze the colony's water pipes.

args.text: The water pipes froze, which is not great for the hospital.

turns.event: A heat wave caused mass heat stroke in the colony.

args.text: Half the colony has heat stroke and it is only getting hotter.

turns.event: An orbital trader appeared selling a jump pack.

args.text: An orbital trader has a jump pack, someone here is about to learn to fly!

turns.event: The colony found a legendary plasteel longsword in an ancient vault.

args.text: A legendary plasteel longsword, Scar is going to love this!

turns.event: A wanderer named Rook joined but immediately fell asleep in the hall.

args.text: [laughter] Our new wanderer walked in and immediately fell asleep on the dining table.

turns.event: A refugee quest offered a hunted scientist who knows how to build a ship.

args.text: A scientist who can build ships wants to hide here, and that is a very tempting offer.

turns.event: A pack of manhunter wolves attacked the colony's caravan.

args.text: Wolves are attacking the caravan, protect the pack animals!

turns.event: The rice crop failed due to a pest infestation.

args.text: Pests ate all the rice, and we were counting on that rice.

turns.after: Buy rice from the next trader.

turns.event: Juno gave birth to a baby girl during a raid.

args.text: Juno just had a baby in the middle of a raid, talk about timing!

turns.event: Mara and Bram got married during a heat wave.

args.text: [laughter] They got married in fifty degree heat, everyone is sweating through their nice clothes.

turns.event: The colonists finished building a giant library.

args.text: The library is done and it is beautiful, everyone is going to be so smart.

turns.event: The research on vanometric power cells just finished.

args.text: Vanometric power cells are researched, which is free power forever!

turns.event: The Backrooms gate opened and a cold wind blew out of it.

args.text: The gate opened and a freezing wind came out, so dress warm on this trip.

turns.event: The expedition team returned with an unconscious stranger.

args.text: They brought someone back from the Backrooms, and nobody knows who they are.

turns.after: Put the stranger in the hospital.

turns.event: The stranger woke up and claims to be an Async Industries employee lost for ten years.

args.text: It is the lost employee from the contract, we found them!

turns.event: The expedition found a room in the Backrooms that is a kitchen with no doors.

args.text: A kitchen with no doors and the stove is still warm, which raises a lot of questions.

turns.event: An anomaly appeared, a cube that hums and floats in the courtyard.

args.text: There is a cube floating in the courtyard and humming, and nobody touched it.

turns.event: Async Industries sent a letter firing the colony for being late with reports.

args.text: [laughter] HQ just fired us by mail, which is bold for a company that needs our gate.

turns.event: A second letter arrived saying the first letter was sent by mistake.

args.text: Never mind, we are un-fired. Corporate has the attention span of a goldfish.

turns.event: A gut worm outbreak hit the colony.

args.text: Gut worms are going around, which is exactly as unpleasant as it sounds.

turns.event: The colony won a fight against a raid of eighteen tribals without losses.

args.text: Eighteen tribals and nobody hurt, this colony is getting good at this.

turns.event: An exploding raider blew up right next to Rook, but he survived.

args.text: That raider exploded next to Rook and he is still standing!

turns.event: A muffalo walked into the hospital and lay down on a bed.

args.text: [laughter] A muffalo walked into the hospital and checked itself into a bed.

turns.event: The colonists completed the ship reactor after three years of work.

args.text: The ship reactor is done, after three years we are almost ready to leave!

turns.after: Prepare for the ship launch event.

turns.event: The ship reactor started and the whole planet is sending raids to stop it.

args.text: The reactor is on and now every enemy on the planet knows it, so we hold for fifteen days.

turns.event: A pirate raid of ten arrived on horseback.

args.text: Ten pirates on horses, which is the most dramatic raid we have had in weeks.

turns.event: A small mechanoid raid of two scythers landed in the barn.

args.text: Two scythers in the barn, so the cows are having a very bad day.

turns.event: Scar was downed by a thrumbo.

args.text: The thrumbo knocked Scar flat, get her out of there!

turns.event: Ivy died in childbirth.

args.text: Ivy did not survive the birth. The baby is alive and healthy.

turns.event: Pip went on a confused wander and walked into the lake.

args.text: [laughter] Pip got confused and walked right into the lake, fully clothed.

turns.after: Pull Pip out of the lake.

turns.event: The battery room exploded during a storm.

args.text: The batteries blew up during the storm, and I am starting to take this personally.

turns.after: Rebuild the batteries in a roofed room.

turns.event: A solar flare cut the power to the freezer during a heat wave.

args.text: Solar flare plus heat wave, so the freezer is basically an oven now.

turns.event: An exotic trader arrived selling a ship's AI persona core.

args.text: Another persona core, and this time we have the silver!

turns.event: A wanderer joined the colony and immediately started a fight with Rook.

args.text: [laughter] The new wanderer joined and punched Rook within an hour. Bold first impression.

turns.event: The colonists finished building the ship hull.

args.text: The ship hull is done, we are actually building a spaceship!

turns.event: The research on ship computer cores just finished.

args.text: Ship computer cores are researched, the ship is getting closer every day!

turns.event: The Backrooms gate opened and someone's voice called Scar's name from inside.

args.text: Something inside the gate just called Scar by name, and nobody here said it.

turns.after: Keep Scar away from the gate.

turns.event: The first day of the ship launch defense began with a raid of twelve mechanoids.

args.text: Day one of the countdown, and the mechs showed up before breakfast.

turns.after: Hold the line around the reactor.

turns.event: The mechanoids were destroyed but Juno lost an eye.

args.text: We held day one, and Juno is going to rock an eyepatch.

turns.event: The ship launched successfully with six colonists aboard.

args.text: The ship is in the sky! Six colonists are heading home after all of this!

turns.think: Chat is celebrating. So am I.

args.text: It really was. Thank you all for being here for every raid and every funeral.

turns.after: Thank the chat and wrap up.

turns.event: The colony's last surviving colonist, Hollis, is alone after a raid killed everyone else.

args.text: It is just Hollis now. Everyone else is gone.
Then we keep going for him. One colonist, one bed, one fresh start.

turns.event: A raid of twenty-four pirates arrived, but a herd of thrumbos walked right into them.

args.text: [laughter] The thrumbos are fighting the pirates for us, this is the best day ever!

turns.event: An ancient danger room was opened by mistake and released three ancient mechanoids.

args.text: Somebody opened the vault by accident, and now we have three angry ancient mechs.

turns.after: Fight the mechs at the vault door.

turns.event: A mortar shell hit the colony's food stockpile.

args.text: A mortar landed right in the food stockpile, and now dinner is scattered across the yard.

turns.event: A drop pod raid landed on the frozen lake and broke through the ice.

args.text: [laughter] They dropped onto the frozen lake and fell right through the ice.

turns.after: Fish them out and capture them.

turns.event: Odessa was downed protecting the children from a scyther.

args.text: Odessa jumped in front of the kids and took the hit, get her to the hospital!

turns.event: Odessa survived and the children are safe.

args.text: Odessa is going to be okay, and the kids are safe because of her.

turns.event: Juno died in a Backrooms expedition when the lights went out.

args.text: The lights went out on the other side, and Juno never came back.

turns.after: Hold a memorial at the gate.

turns.event: Rook is on a murderous rage break targeting the prisoner.

args.text: Rook is trying to kill the prisoner, so somebody needs to stop him.

turns.event: Ivy is on a wander break and won't stop dancing in the rain.

args.text: Ivy is dancing in the rain, and honestly she looks happier than the rest of us.

turns.event: A fire spread to the hospital during a raid.

args.text: The hospital is on fire with patients in it!

turns.event: Lightning struck the solar panels and started a fire.

args.text: Lightning hit the solar panels, which feels like nature making a point.

turns.event: A solar flare knocked out the turrets just as a mech raid arrived.

args.text: Another flare during a mech raid, this game has a sense of humor and I hate it.

turns.event: Toxic fallout killed all the crops in the field.

args.text: The fallout killed every crop in the field. We are going to be hungry.

turns.event: A cold snap killed the colony's chickens.

args.text: The cold took all the chickens. They did not have a warm coop.

turns.event: A heat wave melted the colony's ice sculptures.

args.text: [laughter] The heat wave melted Bram's ice sculptures, he is devastated.

turns.event: An orbital trader arrived selling a pair of bionic legs.

args.text: Bionic legs, Pip can finally run again!

turns.event: The colony found a legendary charge rifle in a vault.

args.text: A legendary charge rifle, Rook just got a huge upgrade!

turns.event: A wanderer named Ivy joined but she is a pyromaniac.

args.text: Our new friend Ivy is a pyromaniac, so the stone walls are about to be very important.

turns.event: A refugee quest brought a pregnant woman who is being chased by raiders.

args.text: A pregnant refugee is asking for help, and raiders are right behind her.

turns.event: A manhunter bear attacked Mara in the woods.

args.text: A bear is attacking Mara in the woods!

turns.event: The healroot crop failed because of a cold snap.

args.text: The cold killed the healroot, so our medicine is going to run low.

turns.event: Bram and Juno had a baby boy during a quiet winter.

args.text: Bram and Juno had a winter baby, the first quiet thing that happened this season.

turns.event: Pip and Tamsin got married in the library.

args.text: Pip and Tamsin got married in the library, which suits two people who argue about books.

turns.event: The colonists finished building a huge temple.

args.text: The temple is done, and it looks incredible.

turns.event: The research on bionics just finished.

args.text: Bionics are researched, so we can build our own arms and legs now!

turns.event: The Backrooms gate opened and released a flood of yellow water.

args.text: The gate opened and yellow water is pouring out across the floor.

turns.event: The expedition team returned covered in yellow slime.

args.text: The team came back covered in yellow slime and nobody wants to talk about it.

turns.event: The expedition found a room with an endless staircase.

args.text: An endless staircase, and the team counted over two hundred steps before giving up.

turns.event: An anomaly appeared, a door in the middle of the field that leads nowhere.

args.text: There is a door standing alone in the field, and when you open it there is just more field.

turns.event: Async Industries sent a letter demanding the colony fill out a form about the form.

args.text: [laughter] HQ sent us a form asking about the form we filled out last week.

turns.event: A plague outbreak killed Bram.

args.text: The plague took Bram. We ran out of medicine one day too early.

turns.event: The colony won a huge fight against a raid of fifty pirates.

args.text: Fifty pirates and we are still standing!

turns.event: A rocket hit the wall right next to the colony's children.

args.text: That rocket landed right next to the kids, get them deeper inside!

turns.event: A colonist accidentally built a wall that trapped him inside a room.

args.text: [laughter] Pip built a wall and trapped himself inside the room.

turns.event: A drop pod landed on top of a pirate, killing him.

args.text: [laughter] A drop pod landed right on top of one of their own guys.

turns.event: A raid of sixteen pirates arrived with flamethrowers.

args.text: Sixteen pirates with flamethrowers, everything wooden is in danger.

turns.after: Keep them away from the wood.

turns.event: A raid of four mechanoids landed inside the colony.

args.text: Four mechs inside the base, everyone fight!

turns.event: A raid of nine pirates arrived and one of them is wearing Bram's old hat.
turns.think: That is Bram's hat. They robbed his grave?

args.text: Wait, is that Bram's hat on that pirate's head?
Looks like it, and now this raid is personal.

turns.after: Focus fire on the hat thief.

turns.event: The hat thief was downed and the colonists recovered Bram's hat.

args.text: Bram's hat is back where it belongs, on the shelf above his old stove.

turns.after: Place the hat on a display shelf.

turns.event: Mara is having a mental break and refuses to eat anything but fine meals.

args.text: Mara is on a food strike until someone cooks her something fancy.

turns.event: The cook made Mara a fine meal and she recovered from her break.

args.text: One nice dinner and Mara is herself again. Food really does solve things.

turns.event: A swarm of manhunter megaspiders broke out of the cave behind the colony.

args.text: Megaspiders coming out of the cave, close every door now!

turns.after: Close the doors and draft shooters.

args.text: [laughter] I am with you, but we still have to fight them.

turns.after: Fight the spiders at the cave mouth.

turns.event: The colonists killed the megaspiders and found a large chunk of insect jelly.

args.text: The spiders are gone and they left us a pile of jelly, so dessert is covered.

turns.after: Haul the jelly to the freezer.

turns.event: The colony is receiving a third raid in three days.

args.text: Third raid in three days, my colonists have not slept since Tuesday.

turns.event: The colonists fought off the third raid but everyone is exhausted and stressed.

args.text: We won again, but everyone is running on empty so tomorrow is a rest day.

turns.event: Scar's prosthetic arm malfunctioned during a fight.

args.text: Scar's arm just glitched mid swing, and she is staring at it like it betrayed her.

turns.event: The arm was fixed and Scar returned to the fight.

args.text: Scar's arm works again and she ran straight back in!

turns.event: A trader caravan arrived with a pet monkey that stole some silver.

args.text: [laughter] The trader's monkey stole a pile of our silver and climbed a tree.

turns.after: Ask the trader to get it back.

turns.event: The trader refused to return the silver.

args.text: The trader says the monkey's earnings are final. That is not how commerce works.

turns.after: Let it go and stop trading with them.

turns.event: A refugee quest brought a child whose village was destroyed.

args.text: A little kid whose village was wiped out is asking for a place to stay.
She is staying, and she gets the warmest room we have.

turns.after: Build a warm room for the child.

turns.event: A huge psychic drone hit the colony and every colonist's mood dropped.

args.text: A psychic drone just hit, so everyone is in a bad mood and nobody knows why.

turns.after: Plan a party to boost moods.

turns.event: Two colonists had mental breaks during the drone.

args.text: Two people snapped during the drone, this day keeps getting worse.

turns.event: The expedition team in the Backrooms reports that their flashlights are dimming.

args.text: Their flashlights are fading, so they need to find the exit fast.

turns.after: Tell the team to hurry back.

turns.event: The team found the exit just as their last flashlight died.

args.text: They walked out the exact second the last light died!

turns.event: Async Industries sent a performance review rating the colony as needs improvement.

args.text: HQ gave us a needs improvement rating, after we fought off a war queen for them.
An appeal sounds great, I will attach a list of every raid we survived.

turns.event: The plague returned, infecting Pip a second time.

args.text: Pip got the plague again, I did not even know that was allowed.

turns.event: A raid of ten pirates arrived and then immediately ran away when they saw the turrets.

args.text: [laughter] They saw the turrets and turned around so fast they dropped their hats.

turns.event: A centipede shot a charge blast that missed Juno by inches and destroyed a statue.

args.text: That blast missed Juno by inches and took out our gold statue instead.

turns.event: The colony elected Scar as its leader.

args.text: Scar is officially our leader, and honestly nobody else stood a chance.

turns.event: A trader caravan arrived and its leader is Juno's old friend.

args.text: The caravan leader is Juno's old friend, so this trade is going to be very friendly.

turns.event: The colonists finished building a giant fountain in the courtyard.

args.text: The fountain is done, and the courtyard finally feels like home.

turns.event: The expedition team returned from the Backrooms with someone who looks exactly like Pip.

args.text: They brought back a second Pip, and the real Pip is standing right here!
I honestly have no idea, so which one do we trust?

turns.event: The Backrooms gate went quiet for a whole week.

args.text: The gate has been completely silent for a week, and that worries me more than noise.

turns.event: A colonist caught a cold and sneezed on the dinner.

args.text: [laughter] Pip sneezed directly onto the stew, so dinner is a mystery now.

turns.event: A raid of five tribals arrived and they all have shields.

args.text: Five tribals with wooden shields, which will not do much against bullets.

turns.event: Hollis lost a leg in a fight with a scyther.

args.text: Hollis lost his leg to a scyther, so he is getting a peg leg until we find better.

turns.event: Ivy was saved from a burning building by Rook.

args.text: Rook ran into the fire and carried Ivy out, that was heroic.

turns.event: A random cow wandered into the colony and joined the herd.

args.text: A wild cow just walked in and joined our herd, welcome friend.

turns.event: The colonists found a working jukebox in a Backrooms room.

args.text: A working jukebox in the Backrooms, we are bringing it home!

turns.event: The colony's last bag of rice was eaten by rats.

args.text: The rats ate our last bag of rice, I am declaring war on rats.

turns.event: A rare thrumbo horn was found on the map.

args.text: A thrumbo horn, that is worth so much silver!

turns.event: The colonists completed the research on long range mineral scanners.

args.text: Long range scanners are done, so we can go find gold now.

turns.event: A pirate raid arrived with a captured colonist from a nearby faction.

args.text: The pirates have a prisoner with them, so let us try to rescue them.

turns.event: The cook burned dinner for the fourth night in a row.
turns.think: Four burnt dinners. Retrain or replace.

args.text: Four nights of burnt dinner. Bram, I love you, but you are off the stove.

turns.event: A raid of thirteen pirates arrived and their leader challenged Scar to a duel.

args.text: Their leader wants a one on one with Scar, this is a movie now!

turns.after: Let Scar fight with her legendary sword.

turns.event: Scar won the duel and the pirates fled.

args.text: Scar won and the whole raid ran home crying!

turns.event: Tamsin died from a stray bullet during an otherwise easy raid.

args.text: It was supposed to be an easy one, and a single stray shot took Tamsin.
It does, because nobody saw it coming. Thanks for sitting with us.

turns.event: A mechanoid cluster started shelling the colony with a mortar mech.

args.text: The cluster has its own mortar, so we cannot hide inside this time.

turns.event: The assault succeeded and the cluster is destroyed.

args.text: Cluster down and every mech is scrap metal now.

turns.event: The colony's dog learned to haul items.

args.text: The dog learned to carry things, so he is officially part of the workforce now.

turns.event: A raid of six pirates got lost and wandered around the map edge for an hour.

args.text: [laughter] The raiders are lost, they have been walking in circles at the edge for an hour.

turns.event: An expedition into the Backrooms found a room full of identical vending machines.

args.text: A room full of vending machines, and every single one is selling the same mystery drink.

turns.event: A volcanic winter ended and the sun is back.

args.text: The sun is back, the plants are back, I might cry a little.

turns.event: A pack of manhunter hares attacked the colony.

args.text: [laughter] We are under siege by bunnies, everybody stay strong!

turns.event: The colony's wind turbine was blown down by a storm.

args.text: The wind turbine got knocked over by the wind, which is a little ironic.

turns.event: A traveling bard asked to perform at the colony.

args.text: A traveling bard wants to play for us, everyone gets a night off.

turns.event: The colonists finished building a mountain bunker for emergencies.

args.text: The bunker is done, so the next big raid is going to have to dig for it.

turns.event: The Async Industries corporate inspector arrived at the colony for an audit.

args.text: HQ sent a real inspector, everybody look busy!

turns.event: The inspector approved the colony and left a bonus payment.

args.text: We passed the audit and they left us a bonus, best paperwork day ever!
